refnamediv.refpurpose: Set the flags for the CachingIterator object

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public voidCachingIterator::setFlags intflags
Replaces the flags of the CachingIterator with flags.
Turning CachingIterator::FULL_CACHE on empties the cache; elements are added to it from the next move of the iterator onwards.
